name: scripttool
description: A library and command line program for working with fdx (Final Draft XML), osf, Fade In and Fountain formatted Screen Play files.
releaseNotes: Requires fountain v1.0.3, fdx v1.0.4 and osf v0.0.9; the go directive is now 1.26.4. Fountain v1.0.3 parses scene numbers (INT. KITCHEN - DAY #12A#) and boneyards, and fdx v1.0.4 writes a scene number as Final Draft's Number attribute and reads it back, so a number survives fountain2fdx and fdx2fountain. A boneyard stays a visible paragraph in FDX and OSF, and OSF keeps no per-scene number.
